run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the first element occurring exactly k times in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct first element detection
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use collections.Counter instead of a manual dictionary count map
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that returns the first array element with frequency equal to k
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty arrays or elements that never reach count k
